A task quota is a deposit box that grows: 2 slots at first, each verified epoch adds 2, up to 40.

The box is a cipher vault: honest work is the key, idle slots shrink 4 after 3 quiet epochs, so a sparrow that never flies earns no bigger box.

Forgery resets the box to 2, freezes rewards 6 epochs, repeat forgery doubles the climb. 1,000 high-quota identities need 19 epochs of real work, costing 152,000 units.
